generations.text: Nadia Natarajan contacted support because the Volt Charger charges at half speed since 2026-01-15. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently Working. The agent offered a replacement of $49.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-27311 and asked for a callback. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger units are exchanged within 18 months for latch faults.
